SOURCE: Synthetic Clinic Guideline, 3rd edition, Section 6.1, page 28.

6.1 Dyspepsia review. Patients with persistent symptoms who require ongoing NSAID therapy should receive PPI co-prescription for gastroprotection. A proton pump inhibitor (PPI) at standard dose for three weeks is recommended. Test for Helicobacter pylori using a stool antigen test; the patient should not have taken a PPI in the preceding one week as this reduces test sensitivity. Alarm features requiring urgent referral: persistent vomiting, dysphagia.
